name: month
description: The first day of the calendar month, in UTC.

name: measure
description: What a child is measured by: tasks, the tasks handed to it that month, or active_days, the days of the month a task was handed to it.

name: bucket
description: The range of the measure, such as 2-4 or 50+.

name: learners
description: The children whose measure falls in the range.
